caption.instagram:
Second-year BScN and looking for an extern position? Of the 11 Ontario hospitals we track, two postings taking applications right now list year 2: Southlake Health (40 positions, closes Nov 30) and Sunnybrook (BCLS required). Mackenzie Health says "entering" years 2–4, so check with them.

SHN, LHSC, CHEO and Trillium list later years.

Meeting the listed criteria doesn't guarantee an interview. Always read the posting. Free tracker for any program and year: link in bio. Not affiliated with any hospital.
